# whisper-large-v3-persian

This model is a fine-tuned version of [openai/whisper-large-v3](https://huggingface.co/openai/whisper-large-v3) on the Common Voice 17.0 dataset.
It achieves the following results on the evaluation set:
- Loss: 0.2499
- Wer: 26.5381

## Model description

The data was fine-tuned using an RTX 6000 ADA graphics card.
Over 200,000 samples were fine-tuned on the system. This data belonged to the Mozilla Foundation's Common Voice 17.0 dataset.
The obtained result, despite improving the Word Error Rate (WER) compared to other models, still has grammatical weaknesses, which is due to spelling errors in the dataset.
